name: python-bloom-filter
title: Bloom Filter over [0, 256)
blurb: A Bloom filter whose added keys are always answered present: the shipped audit re-asks every key after every update on seeded streams, the survey lists the liars at the shipped widths (none), and the rows are deterministic multiplicative hashes.
default_description: A Bloom filter over [0, 256) with zero false negatives on the shipped audit and no absent key answering present at the shipped widths.

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: uv venv --python 3.12 --allow-existing && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff

detect.contains: erases whatever else shares those bits
